evd_title: Idea Novelty Checker achieved accuracy 0.81 F1 0.79 Cohen kappa 0.59 outperforming baselines on expert-annotated dataset
finding: Idea Novelty Checker achieved accuracy 0.81 F1 0.79 Cohen kappa 0.59 outperforming baselines on expert-annotated dataset
P: 32-idea held-out test set (ideas from Scideator + ICLR'22/NeurIPS'23 OpenReview submissions), binary expert novelty labels
I: Idea Novelty Checker: RAG (Semantic Scholar, SPECTER-2, facet RankGPT) + gpt-4o 15-shot expert-labeled examples
C: Expert labels (2 authors); zero-shot, DSPy, TextGRAD, OpenReview-example baselines; AI Scientist, AI Researcher
O: F1 0.79 (kappa 0.59, acc 0.81) vs zero-shot F1 0.65, TextGRAD 0.76, DSPy 0.52-0.58, OpenReview examples 0.43
S: Few-shot LLM evaluation vs expert-annotated held-out test set
T: Ideas from Scideator + ICLR 2022/NeurIPS 2023 OpenReview; gpt-4o run Aug-Sep 2024; paper 2025
